benefit_pkg_computation_rule.description_en:
The computation rule for benefits in the benefit package.

For user tier benefit packages, this value is empty. The quota of effective benefits is calculated based only on the priority.

For user resource benefit packages, this value can be empty or non-empty. When it is non-empty, the benefit package is used to additionally calculate the quotas of existing benefits in other benefit packages, which is limited to quota-type benefits. For example, if a user tier benefit package already includes 10 GB of user storage capacity, you can define one or more user resource benefit packages to add extra storage capacity for specific users.

Supported additional computation rules include:
sum: Accumulates the values when multiple benefit packages contain the same benefit.
max: Takes the maximum value when multiple benefit packages contain the same benefit.
min: Takes the minimum value when multiple benefit packages contain the same benefit
benefit_pkg_computation_rule.description_zh:
权益包内权益的计算规则

用户等级权益包，返回为空，只根据优先级priority计算生效权益的quota。

用户资源权益包，可以返回空值或非空值。返回非空时，该权益包用于追加计算其它权益包中已存在权益的配额，限于quota型权益。如：一个用户等级权益包中已经包含10G用户存储容量，可以再定义一个或多个用户资源权益包，用于给某些用户增加额外的存储容量。

支持的追加计算规则包括：

sum：多个权益包中有相同权益，进行累加

max：多个权益包中有相同权益，取max值

min：多个权益包中有相同权益，取min值
benefit_pkg_computation_rule.title: 权益包内权益的计算规则
